name: PhotoEditorView
description:
`PhotoEditor` over a session the host already holds, for when something outside needs it too. In a
managed window, turn off `header` and `footer` and put `PhotoEditorActions` and `PhotoEditorStatus`
in `Window.Actions` and `Window.Status`.

props.name: backend
props.description: Force a rendering backend. By default the best available is used.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: footer
props.description: Draw the bottom bar. Turn it off to place `PhotoEditorStatus` elsewhere.

props.name: header
props.description: Draw the title bar. Turn it off when a window or dialog supplies one.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ canvasLabel: string; canvasHelp: string; opening: string; openFailed: string; tools: string; crop: string; rotate: string; adjust: string; undo: string; noUndo: string; noRedo: string; redo: string; reset: string; zoomIn: string; zoomOut: string; fit: string; actualSize: string; zoomPercent: (percent: string) => string; size: ({ width, height }: { width: string; height: string; }) => string; cancel: string; close: string; save: string; saving: string; saved: string; saveFailed: string; discardTitle: string; discardBody: string; discardConfirm: string; keepEditing: string; rotateLeft: string; rotateRight: string; flipHorizontal: string; flipVertical: string; brightness: string; contrast: string; saturation: string; warmth: string; sharpen: string; aspectRatio: string; aspectFree: string; aspectOriginal: string; aspectSquare: string; aspectFourThree: string; aspectWide: string; width: string; height: string; applyCrop: string; removeCrop: string; cropArea: string; cropHelp: string; cropReadout: ({ x, y, width, height }: { x: string; y: string; width: string; height: string; }) => string; toolSelected: (tool: string) => string; resetTool: (tool: string) => string; nothingToReset: string; }> | undefined

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Words on the save button, such as "Save to listing".

props.name: tools
props.description: The tools to offer, in order. Pass only what you need: unused tools stay out of the bundle.
